note: Source of truth for the plan. Agents: read AGENTS.md, and change status only through scripts/plan.mjs. size: 1 = up to a week, 2 = one to two weeks, 3 = two to three weeks. placeholder: true means the spec is not written yet, so the task cannot be claimed.

tasks.title: Monorepo, CI, lint and test setup
tasks.done_when: pnpm workspaces build, lint and test in CI on every push

tasks.title: Port Nocturne tokens and components to packages/ui
tasks.done_when: packages/ui exports Nocturne tokens and the btn, input, tag, table and field classes

tasks.title: Domain types and zod contracts for import tabs and config
tasks.done_when: zod schemas for the Ideas, Links, Units, Categories and Assessment tabs, class config and versions, with tests

tasks.title: Postgres schema and migrations
tasks.done_when: Migrations create every entity in ARCHITECTURE.md section 5 and run in CI

tasks.title: SSO sign-in, roles and org tenancy
tasks.done_when: Teachers and students sign in with SSO; every API route checks role and org

tasks.title: Privacy baseline: data inventory, retention, audit log
tasks.done_when: Data inventory doc, retention job and audit_event writes on config changes and publishes

tasks.title: CSV and XLSX import with column mapping
tasks.done_when: fixtures/water-cycle imports from both the CSVs and water-cycle.xlsx into identical RawTabs using the column mapping

tasks.title: Data checks engine
tasks.done_when: The data checks from project/curriculum.js are ported to packages/domain, with a test for each check, including the deliberate errors in fixtures/water-cycle

tasks.title: Derivation: link ranking, layout, quiz generation
tasks.done_when: Link ranking, ring layout and 8-question quiz generation run on import and are stored on the draft version; tests check the rules (at most 3 links in and 3 out, centre and rings, 8 questions) rather than exact output

tasks.title: Job queue and import job producing a draft version
tasks.done_when: Uploading a file runs a pg-boss job that stores a draft CurriculumVersion with derived data and issues

tasks.title: Draft vs published diff and Publish flow
tasks.done_when: The API returns a draft vs published diff, and publishing moves the pinned version for the chosen classes

tasks.title: Exports: template, data-check and alignment reports
tasks.done_when: Template workbook, data-check report and alignment report download as files

tasks.title: Progress migration rules on publish
tasks.done_when: Publishing carries mastery over by idea_id and archives removed ideas, covered by tests

tasks.title: Tracker event catalogue and schemas
tasks.done_when: Every event type in ARCHITECTURE.md section 8.2 has a zod schema in packages/tracker, and the open items in 8.6 are written up

tasks.title: Event ingest API and append-only event store
tasks.done_when: POST /events validates, sets seq, drops duplicate ids and writes partitioned rows; typed text goes to InteractionText; events stream continuously from the client with an offline queue

tasks.title: Deterministic tracker rules: progress, behaviour metrics, signals
tasks.done_when: apply() in packages/tracker is pure with no clock, randomness or network; replaying the same events always gives identical progress, metrics and signals, covered by property tests

tasks.title: Map generation from tracker state
tasks.done_when: generateMap returns a MapView from the version, class config and tracker state; every view is stored and logged with a map.shown event; a check rejects any view that shows a locked idea as open

tasks.title: Teacher trace views: student timeline and class heatmap
tasks.done_when: A teacher can open any progress number or signal and see the events behind it, plus a class heatmap of stalls

tasks.title: Teacher console shell, nav and save state
tasks.done_when: Teacher app shell with header, section nav and the Saving and Saved indicator, behind sign-in

tasks.title: Curriculum data section: import, pipeline, data checks
tasks.done_when: Import, pipeline steps and data checks render from the API, matching the design

tasks.title: Course details with layered config
tasks.done_when: Course details edit class overrides and show whether each value comes from the curriculum or the class

tasks.title: Schedule: due dates per unit
tasks.done_when: Due dates per unit save and appear in the API's missions feed

tasks.title: Card classification overrides
tasks.done_when: Rarity overrides save, with Auto computed from the layout

tasks.title: Read-only data tabs and column mapping UI
tasks.done_when: The Prerequisites, Categories, Standards codes, Media and Assessment tabs and the column mapping editor work

tasks.title: Persona editor: templates, variables, preview, test
tasks.done_when: Templates edit with variable insertion, filled preview and Test through the gateway

tasks.title: Publish screen: diff review and class picker
tasks.done_when: The teacher reviews the diff and checks, picks classes and publishes

tasks.title: AI gateway: server-side calls, prompt fill, rate limits
tasks.done_when: Every model call goes through the API, with prompt filling on the server, per-class rate limits and redacted logs

tasks.title: Student safety: moderation, guardrails, teacher flags
tasks.done_when: Student turns are moderated, fixed guardrails are added after templates, and flags reach the teacher

tasks.title: Resource library and RAG indexing
tasks.done_when: Library uploads are chunked and embedded, and searchLibrary returns ranked passages

tasks.title: Atlas agent with tools
tasks.done_when: Atlas answers with tools (searchIdeas, getDataChecks, getDiff, searchLibrary, draftRows)

tasks.title: Persona eval harness per grade band
tasks.done_when: Fixed eval prompts run per grade band in CI with a pass threshold

tasks.title: Progress snapshots: cached state rebuilt from events
tasks.done_when: The API serves mastery, attempts, XP, cards and Milo stage from ProgressSnapshot, and dropping the cache rebuilds identical values

tasks.title: Student explorer reads published version and class config
tasks.done_when: The student explorer draws the MapView for the class's pinned version and sends interaction events

tasks.title: Missions driven by due dates
tasks.done_when: Missions list uses teacher due dates

tasks.title: Tutor and peer chat through the gateway
tasks.done_when: Ms. Ivy and Milo chats call the gateway with safety on

tasks.title: Pilot: one curriculum shared by two classes
tasks.done_when: Two pilot classes share one curriculum through import, publish, a student run and teach-back

tasks.title: Google Drive import picker
tasks.done_when: Pick a Sheet from Google Drive and import it as a draft

tasks.title: Cloudinary media provider
tasks.done_when: media_url values that point to Cloudinary resolve through a MediaProvider
